depiction_rules.notes: Use only in D029 stanza 1 as the supplied caption names this form. This contract does not establish wider iconography.

visual_bible.appearance: Serene, mature divine healer emerging from the Milky Ocean; blue skin, modest ochre crown and simple cream/maroon drapery.
visual_bible.attributes: One continuous round pot of nectar, held securely in one hand; no extra hands or duplicate vessels.
visual_bible.body: One ordinary two-armed, two-legged humanlike divine body, fully connected and proportionate.
visual_bible.style: Flat matte mineral-pigment temple mural, dark drawn contours and restrained ochre ornament.
